title: Paint Man
body: Your space, painted beautifully. Managed completely.
say: This is Paint Man: a managed house painting service in Agra. Your space, painted beautifully. Managed completely.

title: One team.
body: No finding painters, buying paint or checking the work yourself.
say: Getting a home painted usually means finding painters, buying paint, and checking every wall yourself. With Paint Man, one team handles all of it.

title: Inspection, then an
body: We measure the walls, check for damp and cracks, and quote brand, coats, prep and timeline line by line.
say: It starts with a visit. We measure the walls, check for damp and cracks, and send you an itemised quotation: brand, coats, preparation and timeline, line by line.

title: Every room,
body: Bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens and ceilings.
say: We paint interiors: bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens and ceilings, with the paint brand and range you approve.

title: Built for
body: Crack repair and weather-resistant coats for summer heat, dust and monsoon.
say: Exteriors get crack repair and weather resistant coats, made for Agra's summer heat, dust and monsoon.

title: Ready to
body: Flats and PGs repainted between tenants, with photo updates.
say: And for landlords, we repaint rental flats and P G's between tenants, and send photo updates, even if you live outside Agra.

body: Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac and more, by the code on the shade card.
say: Choosing a colour is easy. Search more than fifty thousand shades from Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac and more, by the code on the shade card, and see each one on a real room.

title: See it on
body: Upload a photo of your room: the walls are found and repainted on your phone.
say: Or upload a photo of your own room. The visualizer finds the walls and repaints them, right on your phone.

title: Supervised,
body: A supervisor checks the work and sends photos. Furniture covered, rooms cleaned.
say: While we paint, a supervisor checks the work and sends you photos every day. Your furniture is covered, and every room is cleaned before we leave.

title: Book your
body: Get a free estimate at paint-man-six.vercel.app
say: Book your inspection online, and get a free estimate. Paint Man. Now booking in Agra.
